title: A Goofy Movie
tagline: Road trip. Fishing rods. Snacks for the whole drive.
about: Goofy drags his teenage son Max on a cross-country fishing trip just as Max is trying to impress Roxanne.
cue: Serve the mains when Goofy and Max run into Pete and P.J. at the campsite.

    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersPerfect Cast Fish FingersPanko-crusted white fish, lemon and a pickle and caper tartare.Practice your Perfect Cast at the pond out back.How to make it600g white fish fillets50g plain flour2 eggs, beaten120g panko breadcrumbs2 L vegetable oil, for frying150g mayonnaise2 dill pickles, chopped1 tbsp capers, chopped1 lemon, cut into wedgesCut the fish into fingers and crumb them in flour, egg, then panko.Stir the mayonnaise with the pickles and capers for the tartare.Fry in batches in the vegetable oil at 180°C for about 3 minutes until golden, then drain.Serve with the tartare and lemon wedges.Powerline NachosCorn chips, spiced beef, black beans, cheddar, guacamole, sour cream, salsa.Powerline plays L.A. this summer. Take the south road at the fork.How to make it400g beef mince1 brown onion, diced2 tsp mild taco spice400g tin black beans, drained125ml water300g corn chips200g cheddar, grated2 avocados1 lime2 tomatoes, diced1 small bunch coriander150g sour creamHeat the oven to 200°C. Brown the mince with the onion.Add the taco spice, black beans and water and simmer.Spread the corn chips on a large tray, spoon over the mince and cover with cheddar, then bake until melted.Mash the avocados with lime and salt, dice the tomatoes with coriander, and top the nachos with guacamole, salsa and sour cream.MainsThe RV Park PlateChargrilled beef sausages in rolls, fried onions, mustard, ketchup, buttered corn.Big rigs and RVs park out back.How to make it8 thick beef sausages2 onions, sliced1 tbsp vegetable oil4 corn cobs30g butter8 long rolls4 tbsp yellow mustard4 tbsp tomato sauceGrill the sausages over hot coals or a barbecue, turning, until charred and cooked through.Fry the onions in the oil until soft and sweet.Grill the corn and brush with butter.Serve the sausages in rolls with the onions, mustard and tomato sauce.SweetsBigfoot S’moresToasted marshmallow and milk chocolate between digestive biscuits.Bigfoot country ahead. Lock your cooler.How to make it16 large marshmallows32 plain biscuits200g milk chocolateToast the marshmallows on skewers over a gas flame or under a hot grill until golden.Squash each between two biscuits with a square of milk chocolate and leave 30 seconds so the chocolate starts to melt.DrinksCherry SlushCherry syrup blended with crushed ice and a squeeze of lime.In the Powerline cup, made to stand out.How to make it200ml cherry cordial600g ice200ml cold water1 lime, juicedBlend the cordial, ice, water and lime juice until smooth and slushy.Pour into tall cups and serve with straws before it melts.
